<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Annisa Nur Aulia | Junior Network Administrator</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Press+Start+2P&family=VT323&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --ink:#1b1b2f; --cream:#fff6d6; --pink:#ff6b9d; --yellow:#ffd93d;
  --teal:#2ec4b6; --blue:#4aa8ff; --purple:#8b5cf6; --green:#4ade80;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:90px}
body{
  font-family:'VT323',monospace;font-size:1.4rem;line-height:1.35;color:var(--ink);
  background:linear-gradient(#3b8cff 0 18%,#4aa8ff 18% 36%,#69b9ff 36% 54%,#8cc9ff 54% 72%,#b3dbff 72% 100%);
  background-attachment:fixed;overflow-x:hidden;
}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:'Press Start 2P',monospace;font-weight:400;line-height:1.6}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.sprite{display:block;image-rendering:pixelated}
[data-sprite]{display:inline-block;line-height:0}
@media (pointer:fine){ body,a,button{cursor:none} }
@media (pointer:coarse){ .pcur{display:none} }

/* Loading */
#load{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10000;background:var(--ink);display:grid;place-items:center;align-content:center;gap:22px;
  color:var(--yellow);font-family:'Press Start 2P';font-size:.9rem;text-align:center;transition:opacity .4s steps(4)}
#load.off{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.ld{width:min(300px,70vw);height:28px;border:4px solid var(--cream);padding:4px}
.ld i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--green);transition:width 1.1s steps(12)}

/* Cursor */
.pcur{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;width:18px;height:18px;background:#fff;border:4px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--pink);
  z-index:9999;pointer-events:none;transition:width .1s steps(2),height .1s steps(2)}
.pcur.big{width:30px;height:30px;background:var(--yellow)}
#fx{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:1;pointer-events:none}
.clouds{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden}
.clouds .c{position:absolute;left:0;animation:drift linear infinite}
@keyframes drift{from{transform:translateX(-320px)}to{transform:translateX(calc(100vw + 320px))}}

/* Nav */
nav{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:1000;background:var(--ink);border-bottom:6px solid var(--yellow);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px 4vw;gap:12px}
#bar{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-6px;height:6px;width:0;background:var(--pink)}
.logo{font-family:'Press Start 2P';font-size:.75rem;color:var(--yellow);display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;white-space:nowrap}
.menu{display:flex;gap:6px;list-style:none}
.menu a{display:block;font-family:'Press Start 2P';font-size:.52rem;padding:11px 11px;color:var(--cream);border:3px solid transparent;line-height:1.4}
.menu a:hover{background:var(--pink);color:var(--ink)}
.menu a.active{background:var(--yellow);color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--cream)}
.right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}
.coins{font-family:'Press Start 2P';font-size:.65rem;color:var(--yellow);display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.burger{display:none;background:var(--yellow);border:4px solid var(--cream);font-family:'Press Start 2P';font-size:.7rem;padding:8px 10px;color:var(--ink)}
@media(max-width:1080px){
  .burger{display:block}
  .menu{position:absolute;top:100%;left:0;right:0;background:var(--ink);flex-direction:column;padding:12px 4vw;display:none;border-bottom:6px solid var(--yellow)}
  .menu.open{display:flex}
  .menu a{font-size:.62rem;padding:14px 12px}
}

section{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:120px 6vw 90px;min-height:100vh}
.banner{display:inline-block;background:var(--yellow);border:5px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:7px 7px 0 var(--ink);
  padding:16px 22px;font-size:clamp(.9rem,2.4vw,1.6rem);margin-bottom:18px}
.sub{display:block;max-width:660px;background:var(--cream);border:4px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--ink);padding:12px 16px;margin-bottom:44px}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px);transition:opacity .5s steps(5),transform .5s steps(5)}
.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}

.panel{background:var(--cream);border:4px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:7px 7px 0 var(--ink);padding:24px;position:relative;
  transition:transform .15s steps(2),box-shadow .15s steps(2)}
.panel:hover{transform:translate(-4px,-4px);box-shadow:11px 11px 0 var(--ink)}
.btn{display:inline-block;font-family:'Press Start 2P';font-size:.7rem;padding:16px 20px;border:4px solid var(--ink);
  box-shadow:6px 6px 0 var(--ink);background:var(--yellow);color:var(--ink);transition:transform .1s steps(2),box-shadow .1s steps(2)}
.btn.alt{background:var(--cream)}
.btn:hover{background:var(--pink)}
.btn:active{transform:translate(6px,6px);box-shadow:0 0 0 var(--ink)}

/* HERO */
#home{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:30px;align-items:center;overflow:hidden;padding-bottom:230px}
.sun{position:absolute;top:100px;right:7vw;width:84px;height:84px;background:var(--yellow);border:6px solid var(--ink);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 10px #ffe98a,0 0 0 16px rgba(255,233,138,.45);animation:sunp 2s steps(2) infinite;z-index:0}
@keyframes sunp{50%{transform:scale(1.08)}}
.badge{display:inline-block;background:var(--ink);color:var(--yellow);font-family:'Press Start 2P';font-size:.6rem;padding:10px 14px;margin-bottom:18px;border:3px solid var(--cream)}
.hi{font-family:'Press Start 2P';font-size:.8rem;color:#fff;text-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--ink);margin-bottom:10px}
h1{font-size:clamp(1.3rem,3.6vw,2.5rem);color:#fff;text-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--ink);margin-bottom:18px}
.term{background:var(--ink);color:var(--yellow);border:4px solid var(--cream);padding:12px 16px;font-size:1.7rem;margin-bottom:18px;min-height:3.2rem}
.term::after{content:'█';margin-left:4px;animation:blink 1s steps(1) infinite}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:0}}
#home .panel{margin-bottom:24px;max-width:560px}
.btns{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.stage{position:relative;min-height:540px;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:flex-end;padding-bottom:44px}
.platform{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(390px,96%);height:48px;border:4px solid var(--ink);
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 28px,rgba(0,0,0,.14) 28px 32px),linear-gradient(var(--green) 0 12px,#2fa84f 12px 20px,#9a6431 20px)}
.girlwrap{position:relative;animation:bob 1.2s steps(2) infinite}
.girlwrap [data-sprite]{cursor:pointer}
@keyframes bob{50%{transform:translateY(-8px)}}
.say{position:absolute;top:-6px;left:58%;background:#fff;border:4px solid var(--ink);padding:10px 12px;font-family:'Press Start 2P';
  font-size:.55rem;line-height:1.7;width:210px;opacity:0;transform:scale(.7);transition:opacity .2s steps(3),transform .2s steps(3);pointer-events:none;z-index:6}
.say.show{opacity:1;transform:none}
.say::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:14px;bottom:-16px;width:14px;height:14px;background:#fff;border-right:4px solid var(--ink);border-bottom:4px solid var(--ink)}
.hint{position:absolute;top:8%;left:2%;font-family:'Press Start 2P';font-size:.5rem;color:#fff;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 var(--ink);animation:blink 1.2s steps(1) infinite}
.fl{position:absolute;animation:bob 1.6s steps(2) infinite;z-index:3}
.f1{top:12%;right:6%}.f2{bottom:30%;left:0}.f3{bottom:18%;right:0;animation-delay:-.6s}.f4{top:30%;left:6%;animation-delay:-.9s}.f5{top:6%;right:30%}
.coin{cursor:pointer}
.coin.got{animation:got .5s steps(5) forwards}
@keyframes got{to{transform:translateY(-60px);opacity:0}}
.plus{position:absolute;font-family:'Press Start 2P';font-size:.6rem;color:#fff;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 var(--ink);pointer-events:none;animation:got .7s steps(6) forwards;z-index:9}
.hill{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:64px;height:170px;pointer-events:none}
.hill.a{background:#7bd88f;clip-path:polygon(0 100%,0 62%,8% 62%,8% 46%,18% 46%,18% 30%,32% 30%,32% 18%,46% 18%,46% 30%,60% 30%,60% 46%,74% 46%,74% 62%,100% 62%,100% 100%)}
.hill.b{background:#52b788;height:120px;clip-path:polygon(0 100%,0 80%,14% 80%,14% 55%,26% 55%,26% 30%,40% 30%,40% 55%,58% 55%,58% 75%,76% 75%,76% 45%,90% 45%,90% 70%,100% 70%,100% 100%)}
.ground{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:64px;border-top:6px solid var(--ink);z-index:2;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 28px,rgba(0,0,0,.14) 28px 32px),linear-gradient(var(--green) 0 14px,#2fa84f 14px 22px,#9a6431 22px)}
.walker{position:absolute;bottom:62px;left:0;z-index:3;animation:walk linear infinite}
@keyframes walk{from{transform:translateX(-120px)}to{transform:translateX(100vw)}}
.walker>div{animation:hop .5s steps(2) infinite}
@keyframes hop{50%{transform:translateY(-12px)}}
.bird{position:absolute;top:16%;left:0;z-index:3;animation:walk 24s linear infinite}
.bird>div{animation:hop 1s steps(2) infinite}
@media(max-width:900px){#home{grid-template-columns:1fr}.stage{min-height:440px}.sun{width:56px;height:56px;top:90px}}

/* ABOUT */
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:300px 1fr;gap:44px;align-items:start}
.frame{position:relative;width:min(280px,100%);margin:0 auto;border:6px solid var(--ink);background:var(--ink);box-shadow:10px 10px 0 var(--pink)}
.frame img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.frame .st{position:absolute}
.tag{display:block;margin:30px auto 0;width:min(280px,100%);text-align:center;background:var(--yellow);border:4px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:6px 6px 0 var(--ink);padding:12px 8px}
.tag b{display:block;font-family:'Press Start 2P';font-size:.65rem;line-height:1.7}
.rows{margin:6px 0 18px}
.row{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:4px dotted var(--ink);flex-wrap:wrap}
.row b{font-family:'Press Start 2P';font-size:.55rem;min-width:110px;line-height:1.8;color:var(--purple)}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:22px}
.stat{text-align:center;padding:14px 6px;background:#fff;border:4px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--ink)}
.stat b{display:block;font-family:'Press Start 2P';font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--pink)}
.stat span{font-size:1.1rem}
@media(max-width:900px){.about{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* LEARN */
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr));gap:26px}
.ico{width:66px;height:66px;border:4px solid var(--ink);background:var(--c,var(--yellow));display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:2rem;box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--ink);margin-bottom:16px}
.panel:hover .ico{animation:wob .4s steps(2) infinite}
@keyframes wob{50%{transform:rotate(-6deg)}}
.panel h4{font-size:.7rem;margin-bottom:10px}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:14px}
.tags span{border:3px solid var(--ink);background:var(--yellow);padding:0 8px;font-size:1.1rem}
.grid .panel:nth-child(4n+1){--c:#ffd93d}.grid .panel:nth-child(4n+2){--c:#ff9ec4}.grid .panel:nth-child(4n+3){--c:#8ee3d8}.grid .panel:nth-child(4n+4){--c:#c4b5fd}

/* PROGRESS */
.topo{margin-bottom:50px;padding:16px}
.topo svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.flow{stroke-dasharray:10 10;animation:dash .8s steps(4) infinite}
@keyframes dash{to{stroke-dashoffset:-20}}
.timeline{position:relative;display:grid;gap:32px}
.timeline::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:26px;top:0;bottom:0;width:8px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(var(--ink) 0 12px,transparent 12px 20px)}
.step{position:relative;margin-left:88px}
.dot{position:absolute;left:-88px;top:14px;width:60px;height:60px;background:var(--yellow);border:4px solid var(--ink);box-shadow:5px 5px 0 var(--ink);
  display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:'Press Start 2P';font-size:1.1rem}
.step h4{font-size:.8rem;margin-bottom:6px}
.status{display:inline-block;font-family:'Press Start 2P';font-size:.5rem;padding:6px 8px;background:var(--teal);border:3px solid var(--ink);margin-bottom:10px}
.step ul{margin:8px 0 18px 22px}
.step li{margin:2px 0}
.seg{display:flex;gap:3px;padding:4px;border:4px solid var(--ink);background:#2b2b44}
.seg span{flex:1;height:20px;background:#3d3d5c}
.seg span.on{background:var(--col,var(--green))}
.pct{text-align:right;font-family:'Press Start 2P';font-size:.65rem;margin-top:10px}
@media(max-width:600px){.timeline::before{left:16px}.step{margin-left:58px}.dot{left:-58px;width:40px;height:40px;font-size:.8rem}}

/* CONTACT */
.cgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:26px;max-width:1040px}
.cgrid .panel{text-align:center}
.cgrid .ico{margin:0 auto 14px}
.cgrid b{display:block;font-family:'Press Start 2P';font-size:.65rem;margin-bottom:10px}
.cgrid span{word-break:break-all;color:var(--purple)}
.zz{position:relative;margin-top:60px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:10px}
.zz i{font-family:'Press Start 2P';font-style:normal;color:#fff;text-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--ink);font-size:.8rem;animation:got 2s steps(8) infinite}
footer{position:relative;z-index:2;background:var(--ink);color:var(--cream);text-align:center;padding:26px 6vw;border-top:6px solid var(--yellow);font-size:1.2rem}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="load"><div>LOADING...</div><div class="ld"><i></i></div><div style="font-size:.6rem">MENYIAPKAN JARINGAN</div></div>
<div class="clouds" id="clouds"></div>
<canvas id="fx"></canvas>
<div class="pcur"></div>

<nav>
  <a href="#home" class="logo"><span data-sprite="router" data-scale="3"></span>ANNISA.TKJ</a>
  <ul class="menu">
    <li><a href="#home" class="active">Home</a></li>
    <li><a href="#about">About Me</a></li>
    <li><a href="#belajar">Apa yang Dipelajari di TKJ</a></li>
    <li><a href="#progress">Progress UKOM</a></li>
    <li><a href="#kontak">Kontak Person</a></li>
  </ul>
  <div class="right">
    <div class="coins"><span data-sprite="coin" data-scale="4"></span><b id="score">0</b></div>
    <button class="burger" aria-label="Menu">MENU</button>
  </div>
  <div id="bar"></div>
</nav>

<!-- HOME -->
<section id="home">
  <div class="sun"></div>
  <div style="position:relative;z-index:4">
    <div class="badge reveal">UJI KOMPETENSI KEAHLIAN 2026</div>
    <div class="hi reveal">HALO, SAYA</div>
    <h1 class="reveal">ANNISA NUR AULIA</h1>
    <div class="term reveal" id="typed"></div>
    <div class="panel reveal">Siswa TKJ yang sedang mengerjakan UKOM Junior Network Administrator. Di sini Anda bisa melihat profil saya, materi yang saya pelajari, dan perkembangan proyek jaringan saya.</div>
    <div class="btns reveal">
      <a href="#progress" class="btn">LIHAT PROGRESS</a>
      <a href="#about" class="btn alt">KENALAN</a>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="stage reveal" style="z-index:4">
    <div class="hint">KLIK AKU DAN KOIN</div>
    <div class="fl f1 coin" data-sprite="coin" data-scale="6"></div>
    <div class="fl f2" data-sprite="router" data-scale="6"></div>
    <div class="fl f3" data-sprite="server" data-scale="6"></div>
    <div class="fl f4 coin" data-sprite="coin" data-scale="5"></div>
    <div class="fl f5" data-sprite="star" data-scale="5"></div>
    <div class="platform"></div>
    <div class="girlwrap">
      <div class="say" id="say">Halo! Aku Annisa.</div>
      <span data-sprite="girl" data-scale="16" id="girl"></span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="hill a"></div><div class="hill b"></div>
  <div class="bird"><div><span data-sprite="bird" data-scale="5"></span></div></div>
  <div class="walker" style="animation-duration:22s"><div><span data-sprite="robot" data-scale="5"></span></div></div>
  <div class="walker" style="animation-duration:34s;animation-delay:-14s"><div style="animation-duration:.7s"><span data-sprite="rabbit" data-scale="5"></span></div></div>
  <div class="ground"></div>
</section>

<!-- ABOUT -->
<section id="about">
  <h2 class="banner reveal">ABOUT ME</h2>
  <span class="sub reveal">Kenalan dulu sebelum masuk ke materi dan proyek.</span>
  <div class="about">
    <div class="reveal">
      <div class="frame">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Foto Annisa Nur Aulia">
        <span class="st" style="top:-30px;left:-34px" data-sprite="star" data-scale="5"></span>
        <span class="st" style="bottom:-30px;right:-34px" data-sprite="heart" data-scale="6"></span>
      </div>
      <div class="tag"><b>PLAYER 1</b>Annisa Nur Aulia</div>
    </div>
    <div class="panel reveal">
      <h3 style="font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:14px">HALO, SAYA ANNISA</h3>
      <div class="rows">
        <div class="row"><b>NAMA</b><span>Annisa Nur Aulia</span></div>
        <div class="row"><b>KELAS</b><span>12 TKJ A</span></div>
        <div class="row"><b>SEKOLAH</b><span>SMKN 1 Kota Bekasi</span></div>
        <div class="row"><b>MISI</b><span>UKOM Junior Network Administrator</span></div>
      </div>
      <p>Saya siswa jurusan Teknik Komputer dan Jaringan. Fokus saya membangun jaringan yang berjalan, mulai dari router, server, database, sampai website.</p>
      <div class="stats">
        <div class="stat"><b data-count="4">0</b><span>Tahap UKOM</span></div>
        <div class="stat"><b data-count="8">0</b><span>Materi inti</span></div>
        <div class="stat"><b data-count="2">0</b><span>Jenis client</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- BELAJAR -->
<section id="belajar">
  <h2 class="banner reveal">APA YANG DIPELAJARI DI TKJ</h2>
  <span class="sub reveal">Delapan materi inti di jurusan Teknik Komputer dan Jaringan.</span>
  <div class="grid">
    <div class="panel reveal"><div class="ico">🌐</div><h4>Dasar Jaringan</h4><p>Model OSI dan TCP/IP, pengalamatan IP, subnetting, dan cara perangkat saling berkomunikasi.</p><div class="tags"><span>OSI</span><span>TCP/IP</span><span>Subnet</span></div></div>
    <div class="panel reveal"><div class="ico">🔌</div><h4>Kabel dan Perangkat</h4><p>Crimping kabel UTP, pengujian dengan LAN tester, pemasangan switch dan access point.</p><div class="tags"><span>UTP</span><span>Crimping</span><span>Switch</span></div></div>
    <div class="panel reveal"><div class="ico">📶</div><h4>Router MikroTik</h4><p>Konfigurasi IP address, DHCP server, NAT, dan hotspot menggunakan Winbox.</p><div class="tags"><span>Winbox</span><span>DHCP</span><span>NAT</span></div></div>
    <div class="panel reveal"><div class="ico">🖥️</div><h4>Server Linux</h4><p>Instalasi Ubuntu Server, pengaturan IP statis, dan pengelolaan layanan lewat terminal.</p><div class="tags"><span>Ubuntu</span><span>Netplan</span><span>SSH</span></div></div>
    <div class="panel reveal"><div class="ico">🧭</div><h4>Layanan Jaringan</h4><p>Pembuatan layanan DNS, web server, dan FTP agar komputer lain bisa mengakses server.</p><div class="tags"><span>DNS</span><span>Apache</span><span>FTP</span></div></div>
    <div class="panel reveal"><div class="ico">🗄️</div><h4>Basis Data</h4><p>Membuat database, tabel, dan user dengan MySQL atau MariaDB untuk kebutuhan website.</p><div class="tags"><span>MariaDB</span><span>SQL</span><span>phpMyAdmin</span></div></div>
    <div class="panel reveal"><div class="ico">🛡️</div><h4>Keamanan Jaringan</h4><p>Firewall, pembatasan akses, dan pengamanan password pada router serta server.</p><div class="tags"><span>Firewall</span><span>Filter</span><span>Password</span></div></div>
    <div class="panel reveal"><div class="ico">🔧</div><h4>Troubleshooting</h4><p>Mencari penyebab jaringan putus dengan ping, traceroute, dan pengecekan konfigurasi.</p><div class="tags"><span>ping</span><span>traceroute</span><span>log</span></div></div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- PROGRESS -->
<section id="progress">
  <h2 class="banner reveal">PROGRESS UKOM</h2>
  <span class="sub reveal">Perkembangan proyek Junior Network Administrator. Ubah angka progress lewat atribut data-val pada tiap bar.</span>
  <div class="panel topo reveal"><div id="topo"></div></div>
  <div class="timeline">
    <div class="step reveal"><div class="dot">1</div>
      <div class="panel"><span class="status">JARINGAN HOTSPOT DAN KABEL</span><h4>Konfigurasi Router MikroTik</h4>
        <ul><li>Mengatur IP address dan gateway pada interface</li><li>Membuat DHCP server untuk client</li><li>Mengaktifkan NAT masquerade agar client bisa ke internet</li><li>Membuat jaringan hotspot untuk client WiFi</li><li>Menyiapkan jaringan untuk client kabel</li></ul>
        <div class="seg" data-val="100" style="--col:#ff6b9d"></div><div class="pct">0%</div></div></div>
    <div class="step reveal"><div class="dot">2</div>
      <div class="panel"><span class="status">SERVER</span><h4>Instalasi Server Ubuntu</h4>
        <ul><li>Instalasi Ubuntu Server</li><li>Pengaturan IP statis</li><li>Akses jarak jauh lewat SSH</li><li>Pengujian koneksi ke router dan client</li></ul>
        <div class="seg" data-val="80" style="--col:#4aa8ff"></div><div class="pct">0%</div></div></div>
    <div class="step reveal"><div class="dot">3</div>
      <div class="panel"><span class="status">MARIADB</span><h4>Database</h4>
        <ul><li>Instalasi MariaDB atau MySQL</li><li>Membuat database dan user</li><li>Membuat tabel untuk data website</li></ul>
        <div class="seg" data-val="55" style="--col:#8b5cf6"></div><div class="pct">0%</div></div></div>
    <div class="step reveal"><div class="dot">4</div>
      <div class="panel"><span class="status">WEB SERVER</span><h4>Website</h4>
        <ul><li>Instalasi Apache dan PHP</li><li>Menyambungkan website ke database</li><li>Pengujian akses dari client hotspot dan client kabel</li></ul>
        <div class="seg" data-val="30" style="--col:#2ec4b6"></div><div class="pct">0%</div></div></div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- KONTAK -->
<section id="kontak">
  <h2 class="banner reveal">KONTAK PERSON</h2>
  <span class="sub reveal">Hubungi saya untuk bertanya atau berdiskusi soal jaringan.</span>
  <div class="cgrid">
    <a class="panel reveal" href="https://www.instagram.com/annsanraa/" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><div class="ico" style="--c:#ff9ec4">📸</div><b>INSTAGRAM</b><span>@annsanraa</span></a>
    <a class="panel reveal" href="http://www.linkedin.com/in/annisa-nur-aulia" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><div class="ico" style="--c:#4aa8ff">💼</div><b>LINKEDIN</b><span>linkedin.com/in/annisa-nur-aulia</span></a>
    <a class="panel reveal" href="mailto:annisanuraulia468@gmail.com"><div class="ico" style="--c:#ffd93d">✉️</div><b>EMAIL</b><span>annisanuraulia468@gmail.com</span></a>
    <div class="panel reveal"><div class="ico" style="--c:#8ee3d8">🏫</div><b>SEKOLAH</b><span>SMKN 1 Kota Bekasi</span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="zz"><span data-sprite="cat" data-scale="7"></span><i>Z</i><i style="animation-delay:.7s">z</i></div>
</section>

<footer>© 2026 Annisa Nur Aulia. Kelas 12 TKJ A, SMKN 1 Kota Bekasi.</footer>

<script>
const $=(s,c=document)=>c.querySelector(s), $$=(s,c=document)=>[...c.querySelectorAll(s)];
const INK='#1b1b2f';

/* ===== Sprite pixel ===== */
const SP={
 girl:{pal:{h:'#7a6a85',s:'#f3c9a5',e:'#2b1d1d',b:'#f59aa5',m:'#c2566b',L:'#cfd8e3',c:'#5eead4',d:'#12263a',p:'#33406b',k:'#222233'},
  rows:[
 "....hhhhhhhh....",
 "...hhhhhhhhhh...",
 "..hhhhhhhhhhhh..",
 "..hhsssssssshh..",
 "..hssssssssssh..",
 "..hssessssessh..",
 "..hsbssssssbsh..",
 "..hssssmmssssh..",
 "..hhsssssssshh..",
 "...hhhhhhhhhh...",
 "..hhhhhhhhhhhh..",
 ".hhhhhhhhhhhhhh.",
 ".hLLLLLLLLLLLLh.",
 ".hLddccccccddLh.",
 ".hLdccddddccdLh.",
 ".hLddccccccddLh.",
 ".hLLLLLLLLLLLLh.",
 "..sLLLLLLLLLLs..",
 "...pppp..pppp...",
 "...kkkk..kkkk..."],blink:true},
 robot:{pal:{y:'#ffd93d',m:'#9fb3c8',M:'#6b7f95',c:'#5eead4',k:'#222233',r:'#ef4444'},
  rows:[".....yy.....",".....mm.....","..mmmmmmmm..",".mmmmmmmmmm.",".mccmmmmccm.",".mccmmmmccm.",".mmmmmmmmmm.",".mmkkkkkkmm.","..MMMMMMMM..",".mmmyyyymmm.","mmmmyrrymmmm",".mmmmmmmmmm.","..MM....MM..","..kk....kk.."]},
 cat:{pal:{o:'#f59e0b',k:'#222233',p:'#ff9ec4',w:'#fff6d6'},
  rows:["..oo......oo..","..oooooooooo..",".oooooooooooo.",".okkooooookko.",".oooooppooooo.",".ooooowwooooo.","..oooooooooo..","..oooooooooo..","..owwoooowwo..","..oo......oo.."]},
 rabbit:{pal:{w:'#f8fafc',p:'#ff9ec4',k:'#222233'},
  rows:["..ww..ww..","..wp..wp..","..wp..wp..","..wwwwww..",".wwwwwwww.",".wkwwwwkw.",".wwwppwww.",".wwwwwwww.","..wwwwww..",".wwwwwwww.",".wwwwwwww.",".ww....ww."]},
 bird:{pal:{b:'#38bdf8',k:'#222233',y:'#ffd93d'},flap:true,
  rows:["b.......b","bb.....bb",".bbbbbbb.","..bbkbby.","...bbbb..","........."],
  alt:["........." ,".bbbbbbb.","..bbkbby.","bbbbbbbbb","b..bbb..b","........."]},
 router:{pal:{a:'#1f2937',g:'#6b7280',G:'#1f2937',l:'#4ade80',r:'#ef4444'},
  rows:["..a......a....","..a......a....","..a......a....","gggggggggggggg","gGGGGGGGGGGGGg","gGlGlGrGGGGGGg","gggggggggggggg",".GG........GG."]},
 server:{pal:{g:'#9ca3af',G:'#1f2937',l:'#4ade80',r:'#ef4444'},
  rows:["gggggggggg","gGGGGGGlGg","gggggggggg","gGGGGGGlGg","gggggggggg","gGGGGGGrGg","gggggggggg","..G....G.."]},
 heart:{pal:{r:'#ff4d6d'},rows:[".rr.rr.","rrrrrrr","rrrrrrr",".rrrrr.","..rrr..","...r..."]},
 coin:{pal:{y:'#ffd93d',Y:'#d99a00'},rows:["..yy..",".yYYy.","yYyyYy","yYyyYy",".yYYy.","..yy.."]},
 star:{pal:{y:'#ffd93d'},rows:["...y...","...y...","yyyyyyy",".yyyyy.","..yyy..",".yy.yy.","yy...yy"]},
 cloud:{pal:{w:'#ffffff',l:'#d6ecff'},outline:false,
  rows:["....wwww........","..wwwwwwww.www..",".wwwwwwwwwwwwww.","wwwwwwwwwwwwwwww",".llllllllllllll."]}
};
function draw(rows,pal,sc,outline){
  const w=Math.max(...rows.map(r=>r.length)),h=rows.length,pad=outline?1:0;
  const c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=(w+pad*2)*sc;c.height=(h+pad*2)*sc;c.className='sprite';
  const g=c.getContext('2d'),f=(i,j)=>i>=0&&j>=0&&j<h&&i<w&&pal[rows[j][i]];
  if(outline){g.fillStyle=INK;for(let j=-1;j<=h;j++)for(let i=-1;i<=w;i++){if(!f(i,j)&&(f(i+1,j)||f(i-1,j)||f(i,j+1)||f(i,j-1)))g.fillRect((i+pad)*sc,(j+pad)*sc,sc,sc)}}
  for(let j=0;j<h;j++)for(let i=0;i<w;i++){const col=pal[rows[j][i]];if(col){g.fillStyle=col;g.fillRect((i+pad)*sc,(j+pad)*sc,sc,sc)}}
  return c;
}
const MOB=innerWidth<700?.7:1;
function mount(el){
  const s=SP[el.dataset.sprite];if(!s)return;
  const sc=Math.max(2,Math.round(+el.dataset.scale*MOB)),ol=s.outline!==false;
  const a=draw(s.rows,s.pal,sc,ol);el.appendChild(a);
  const altRows=s.alt||(s.blink?s.rows.map(r=>r.replace(/e/g,'s')):null);
  if(altRows){
    const b=draw(altRows,s.pal,sc,ol);b.style.display='none';el.appendChild(b);
    if(s.flap)setInterval(()=>{const t=a.style.display==='none';a.style.display=t?'block':'none';b.style.display=t?'none':'block'},220);
    if(s.blink)setInterval(()=>{a.style.display='none';b.style.display='block';setTimeout(()=>{a.style.display='block';b.style.display='none'},160)},3200);
  }
}
$$('[data-sprite]').forEach(mount);

/* Awan */
(function(){const box=$('#clouds');[[8,70,5],[22,110,7],[40,90,4],[58,130,6],[74,100,5]].forEach(([top,dur,sc],i)=>{
  const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='c';d.style.top=top+'%';d.style.animationDuration=dur+'s';d.style.animationDelay=(-i*22)+'s';
  d.appendChild(draw(SP.cloud.rows,SP.cloud.pal,sc*(MOB<1?.7:1),false));box.appendChild(d)})})();

/* Loading */
requestAnimationFrame(()=>{$('.ld i').style.width='100%'});
setTimeout(()=>$('#load').classList.add('off'),1500);

/* Kursor dan jejak piksel */
const pc=$('.pcur'),cv=$('#fx'),cx=cv.getContext('2d');let W,H,trail=[];
function rs(){W=cv.width=innerWidth;H=cv.height=innerHeight}addEventListener('resize',rs);rs();
const cols=['#ff6b9d','#ffd93d','#4ade80','#4aa8ff','#8b5cf6'];
addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{
  pc.style.transform=`translate(${e.clientX-9}px,${e.clientY-9}px)`;
  trail.push({x:Math.round(e.clientX/6)*6,y:Math.round(e.clientY/6)*6,l:1,c:cols[Math.random()*5|0]});
  if(trail.length>40)trail.shift();
});
(function loop(){cx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);trail.forEach(p=>{p.l-=.04;if(p.l>0){cx.globalAlpha=p.l;cx.fillStyle=p.c;const s=Math.ceil(10*p.l/2)*2;cx.fillRect(p.x,p.y,s,s)}});
  trail=trail.filter(p=>p.l>0);cx.globalAlpha=1;requestAnimationFrame(loop)})();
$$('a,button,.coin,#girl').forEach(el=>{el.addEventListener('mouseenter',()=>pc.classList.add('big'));el.addEventListener('mouseleave',()=>pc.classList.remove('big'))});

/* Koin dan karakter */
let score=0;
$$('.coin').forEach(c=>c.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  if(c.classList.contains('got'))return;
  c.classList.add('got');score++;$('#score').textContent=score;
  const p=document.createElement('div');p.className='plus';p.textContent='+1';
  const r=c.getBoundingClientRect(),sr=$('.stage').getBoundingClientRect();
  p.style.left=(r.left-sr.left)+'px';p.style.top=(r.top-sr.top)+'px';$('.stage').appendChild(p);setTimeout(()=>p.remove(),700);
  setTimeout(()=>c.classList.remove('got'),2500);
}));
const lines=['Halo! Aku Annisa.','Ayo konfigurasi router!','Ping berhasil!','Semangat UKOM!','Server Ubuntu siap!','Hotspot sudah aktif!'];
let li=0,tm;
$('#girl').addEventListener('click',()=>{const s=$('#say');s.textContent=lines[li++%lines.length];s.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(tm);tm=setTimeout(()=>s.classList.remove('show'),2200)});

/* Mengetik */
const words=['Junior Network Administrator','Router MikroTik','Server Ubuntu','Database dan Website'];
let wi=0,ci=0,del=false;const tp=$('#typed');
(function type(){const w=words[wi];tp.textContent='> '+w.slice(0,ci);
  if(!del&&ci<w.length)ci++;else if(!del){del=true;return setTimeout(type,1200)}
  else if(del&&ci>0)ci--;else{del=false;wi=(wi+1)%words.length}
  setTimeout(type,del?40:90)})();

/* Topologi pixel */
(function(){
  const N=[
   ['Internet','ISP',20,185,120,64,'#b3dbff'],['MikroTik','Router',290,165,120,100,'#ffd93d'],
   ['Access Point','Hotspot',520,56,140,64,'#ff9ec4'],['Client WiFi','',710,18,100,50,'#fff6d6'],['Client HP','',710,98,100,50,'#fff6d6'],
   ['Switch','LAN',520,186,140,64,'#8ee3d8'],['PC Kabel 1','',710,158,100,50,'#fff6d6'],['PC Kabel 2','',710,224,100,50,'#fff6d6'],
   ['Ubuntu Server','Web + Database',520,308,210,76,'#c4b5fd']];
  const L=['M140 217 L290 217','M410 190 C460 190 460 88 520 88','M660 88 L710 43','M660 88 L710 123','M410 217 L520 217','M660 218 L710 183','M660 218 L710 249','M410 245 C460 245 460 346 520 346'];
  let s='<svg viewBox="0 0 830 410" shape-rendering="crispEdges" font-family="VT323, monospace">';
  s+='<g fill="none" stroke="#ff6b9d" stroke-width="5" class="flow">'+L.map(d=>`<path d="${d}"/>`).join('')+'</g>';
  L.forEach((d,i)=>{s+=`<path id="p${i}" d="${d}" fill="none"/>`;s+=`<rect x="-5" y="-5" width="10" height="10" fill="#ffd93d" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="2"><animateMotion dur="${2+i*.3}s" repeatCount="indefinite"><mpath href="#p${i}"/></animateMotion></rect>`});
  N.forEach(([a,b,x,y,w,h,c])=>{
    s+=`<rect x="${x+6}" y="${y+6}" width="${w}" height="${h}" fill="${INK}"/><rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${w}" height="${h}" fill="${c}" stroke="${INK}" stroke-width="4"/>`;
    s+=`<text x="${x+w/2}" y="${y+h/2+(b?-2:7)}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="22" fill="${INK}">${a}</text>`;
    if(b)s+=`<text x="${x+w/2}" y="${y+h/2+20}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" fill="#4b4b6b">${b}</text>`;
  });
  $('#topo').innerHTML=s+'</svg>';
})();

/* Reveal, bar segmen, angka */
const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(e.target)}}),{threshold:.12});
$$('.reveal').forEach((el,i)=>{el.style.transitionDelay=(i%4)*.07+'s';io.observe(el)});
$$('.seg').forEach(b=>{for(let i=0;i<20;i++)b.appendChild(document.createElement('span'))});
const io2=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{
  if(!e.isIntersecting)return;io2.unobserve(e.target);const t=e.target;
  if(t.matches('.seg')){const v=+t.dataset.val,n=Math.round(v/5),sp=$$('span',t),pct=t.nextElementSibling;let k=0;
    const id=setInterval(()=>{if(k<n){sp[k].classList.add('on');k++;pct.textContent=Math.round(k*5)+'%'}else{pct.textContent=v+'%';clearInterval(id)}},70)}
  else{const end=+t.dataset.count;let n=0;const id=setInterval(()=>{n++;t.textContent=n;if(n>=end)clearInterval(id)},160)}
}),{threshold:.6});
$$('.seg,[data-count]').forEach(el=>io2.observe(el));

/* Menu aktif, progress gulir, burger */
const links=$$('.menu a');
const io3=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)links.forEach(a=>a.classList.toggle('active',a.getAttribute('href')==='#'+e.target.id))}),{rootMargin:'-45% 0px -50% 0px'});
$$('section').forEach(s=>io3.observe(s));
addEventListener('scroll',()=>{const h=document.documentElement;$('#bar').style.width=(h.scrollTop/(h.scrollHeight-h.clientHeight)*100)+'%'});
$('.burger').onclick=()=>$('.menu').classList.toggle('open');
links.forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',()=>$('.menu').classList.remove('open')));
</script>
</body>
</html>
